items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Were you on the show when John and Yoko came on Merv Griffin?

ctx.x: the screaming trumpet, didn’t he? On “Northwest Passage” and all? Yeah he’s a great trumpet player. Mostly anything we did was funny. Nothing was too hairy.
Were you on the show when John and Yoko came on Merv Griffin?
No, I think that must have been in New York. Well I don’t know was it out here? If it was out here I was on it, yeah.
